record.question: Let us go up the hill. Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer B: Preposition. “Up” is a preposition here because it takes the object “the hill”. Independent check: “Up” is followed by “the hill,” its noun-phrase complement; it functions as a preposition. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/prepositions.
